notes.title: Full Release v1.7.1
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Reverted seasonal visuals
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated Linux build to match Windows and Mac
[*]Fixed Mac build not launching on Steam client
[*]Fixed hat display in item shop being shown behind the UI
[*]Removed random blank cube from Toxic Lab
[*]Fixed voice chat errors on Dojo
[/list]

notes.title: Full Release v1.6.0
notes.content:
v1.6.0

Features:
[list]
[*] New Maps: World 1 and Shinjuku
[*] Chat text size setting
[*] Separate voice chat room for dead players
[*] Random name colours in chat for visual clarity
[*] Main maps and Workshop maps have been separated with tabs
[*] Added discord rich presence
[*] Can now play custom maps in solo matches against bots (Experimental)
[*] Player's regain their health back after every kill in Laser Tag
[*] Minor adjustments to Inkcap cosmetic materials
[*] New fancy background on paid items in Customize menu
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Transition effect will no longer act silly during Laser Tag matches.
[*] Bot performance and lag improvement
[*] Fixed laser tag spawns not being in the correct position for custom maps
[*] Fixed laser tag spawns not working on Skylines
[*] Fixed voice chat not working on toxic lab and dojo
[*] Jump ramps on custom maps no longer push you in the opposite direction
[*] Players should now see a kick message when kicked from a lobby
[*] Fixed slow powerup persisting and stacking on players in laser tag
[*] Increased sensitivity on the map creator scrollbar
[*] Added click sounds to more buttons in the menus 
[*] Fixed material issue with Bunny Ears cosmetic.
[*] Added shader to barriers on Shinjuku
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] Sometimes bots on Shinjuku go outside the map
[*] Animated objects in some maps may not be properly synchronised for other players
[/list]

notes.title: Full Release v1.2.1
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Fixed stunned effect issue in spectate.
- Fixed issue where ragdoll displays hat color incorrectly.
- Fixed Skylines lobby map and collider issues.
- Fixed issue with speed lines where they would play infinitely.
- Fixed issue where purchasing an item would set the menu song incorrectly.
- Fixed Hide and Seek always displaying the Seeker to be the winner.
- Fixed a faulty Jump Pad in Ruins.
- Adjusted windows in Ruins so you shouldn't get stuck as often.
- Tutorial now teaches you how to obtain/use Powerups.
- New portal sound.
- Slightly changed look of main menu background.

Known Issues:
- The volume for the SFX on skylines may be a little inconsistent
- Trains on last stop disappearing for players who join mid match (We have identified this issue and will try to fix it)

notes.title: Full Release v1.1.2
notes.content:
- In-game lobby list now shows bots.
- Fixed EXP being atleast 500 every single game unintentionally.
- Fixed Lightbulb hat being too bright.
- Fixed Tag Me hat causing you to not be able to join matches.
- New Robot Eye hat color.
- New Durag model and colors.
- In-game lobby list now displays which player is the Host.
- Can now rebind Voice Chat, powerup, and lobby list buttons.
- Minor changes to Shroomville and Ruins.
- Bots with Hide and Seek should no longer break when the bots win.

Known issues: 
Pressing the purchase button in the Item Shop causes the music to restart.

notes.title: Full Release v1.1.1
notes.content:
- New hazard for Temple.
- New track for Temple.
- Fixed background for player icons in in-game lobby list.
- Fixed Hide and Seek not working properly with bots.
- Fixed new skins causing the game to crash. 
- Tweaked EXP gained for all modes.

Known issues:
- EXP still needs tweaking! It will likely be in a fully polished state by next update.
- We've noticed some hats are STILL encountering the crash issue, these will also be fixed in the next 
   update along with the EXP, stay tuned!

notes.title: Full Release 1.1.0
notes.content:
- Removed host migration
- Removed discord rich presence
- Holding [TAB] in game will show you a list of players that are currently in the lobby
- Fixed bot pathing on Colosseum
- Can now turn the player model preview in the main menu
- New unlockable hats (Clown, Tag Me)
- New purchasable hats (Julius, Barbara, Flask, Craig)
- Player ragdolls should now have the proper hat colour applied to them
- Some new hints during loading screens

Host Migration only worked some of the time and was causing too many issues with people. That and the load times being bad were the main reasons we chose to remove it

There were instances of people's discord opening instead of the game. This was due to the discord SDK being added to the game but it has since been removed

notes.title: Full Release v1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Full Release v1.0.1[/b]

[b]Features:[/b]
- Slightly expanded Colosseum
- New images for loading screens
- New thumbnails for some maps

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed Jump Pads for Ruins/Colosseum
- Fixed Powerup display issue while spectating
- Can no longer go out of bounds on Colosseum
- Bots should no longer explode improperly and cause issues on Last Stop/Shroomville
- Chat should no longer disappear seemingly at random
- Player ragdolls should now spawn with the correct hat color
- Fixed loading screens
- Fixed Dash VFX visual bug

notes.title: Early Access v1.3.3
notes.content:
Early Access v1.3.3

Features:
- New menu backgrounds

Fixes:
- Fixed bug where match would crash on restart if at least 1 player had no hat on
- Adjusted the Temple map
- Fixed issue where player loadout wasn't being saved if they weren't wearing a hat

notes.title: Early Access v1.3.2
notes.content:
Early Access v1.3.2

Features:
- New unique loading screens for each map (excluding custom maps)

Fixes:
- Moved socials from title screen to main menu
- Player loadout now saves when you exit and relaunch the game
- Solo matches should now be playable offline without WiFi
- HUD adjustments
- Fixed map builder bug where you could spawn in a lobby map

notes.title: Early Access v1.3.1
notes.content:
Early Access v1.3.1

Features:
- Added socials to the main menu
- New powerup holder HUD element

Fixes:
- Fixed bugs regarding player joining while match is in progress (please let us know if anything goes wrong)
- Players can now push bots in solo match
- Fixed instances of lobby maps not being set to the correct position when playing a custom map
- Fixed players being given blank powerups (the white square)
- Improved bot AI to make them run away after tagging someone
- Fixed instances where player would sometimes get stuck on the ceiling for a few seconds after jumping

Known Issues:
- Not all audio formats work when trying to import music for your custom maps, try to mess around with different file formats (mp3, wav, ogg) and codecs

notes.title: Early Access v1.2.2
notes.content:
Early Access v1.2.2

Features:
- Added a new Dash feature that can be used when the 'Left Shift' key is pressed

Fixes:
- Player's should no longer crash after dying
- Powerups now disappear when a match ends
- Fixed audience sound playing when volume is set to 0%
- Last Stop and Shroomville adjustments

notes.title: Early Access v1.2.1
notes.content:
Early Access v1.2.1

Fixes:
- Shardo headset should now be fully working in game (sorry about that)
- Accessing the chat box no longer freezes the player
- Player's can no longer hear themselves when using voice chat
- Player can no longer move after 10 seconds when they're chosen at the start of the infection and hide & seek game modes
- The slow powerup should not affect dead players anymore
- Tagged players in infection using the slow powerup won't slow down other tagged players
- Player's should now be able to see the powerup of the person they are spectating
- Textures in the map importer should have no filtering applied to them now
- Last Stop and Shroomville adjustments
- Full list of controls visible in settings

Known Issues:
- Map importer can't support models with negative scale values and will force the scale to be positive. You must apply the scale using before exporting your map in whatever software you used to make it

notes.title: Early Access v1.2
notes.content:
Early Access v1.2

Features:
- Powerups have been completely revamped are now activated using the 'E' key
- You can send messages in the text chat by pressing the 'Y' key
- You can enable push to talk voice chat by holding the 'T' key
- 1 new cosmetic
- Splash Screen
- Added version checks to lobbies to avoid version mismatches

Fixes:
- Collision tagging should now work with less delay
- Adjusted Last Stop and Temple maps
- Infection and Hide & Seek grace periods changed from 10 to 20
- Changed the it player's bomb time in the Hide & Seek game mode from 120 seconds to 180 seconds
- Danger effect adjusted
- Push mechanic delay set to 1 second
- Map importer can now support meshes with multiple materials
- You can now see your map when you try and edit it in the map importer
- Added checks to lobbies if the player doesn't own a custom map
- Tutorial now has its own music track

notes.title: Early Access v1.1 Update
notes.content:
Early Access V1.1



Features:

- Added a new Temple map

- Added a push mechanic that lets you push away nearby players in game

- Added a map importer that lets you import your own custom maps and upload them to the Steam Workshop and play them online with other people

- Replaced the colour wheel in the loadout menu with eight different colours to choose from

- Added new music tracks to all maps



Fixes:

- Loadout menu options now highlighted so that you know which one is currently selected

- Fixed issue where the default map in the host menu was set to an old cut map

- Possibly fixed the issue where cosmetics for some people are floating

- Possibly fixed an issue where if the hiders win in a hide and seek game, it'll sometimes say the seekers won



Known issues:

- If you join a lobby that is hosting a custom workshop map and you don't have the map downloaded, your game may crash or play without a map
